text:
Rajat (PM): dropping the updated figma + interactive prototype for the evals scorecard + diff list. main asks: quick feedback on (1) row 'compactness' control (slider vs presets), (2) inline threshold editing vs modal, (3) keyboard shortcuts for approve/skip, (4) how we surface new regressions for screen readers. link: https://www.figma.com/file/xxx/evals-proto

Maya (Designer): saw the proto — love the concept. slider feels powerful but could be confusing. prefer 3 presets (comfortable / compact / condensed) with a small preview. defaults: comfortable for new users, compact for power users.

Lukas (Frontend): presets good call. technically easier to map to CSS vars for row spacing. big caveat: virtualization + variable row heights gets hairy if rows expand (eg. long diffs). suggestion: limit condensed -> fixed-height rows, show 'expand' chevron to reveal full diff.

Priya (A11y): accessibility nits: condensed mode must maintain 4.5:1 contrast for all text and interactive elements. keyboard focus must be obvious (not just background change). for announcing new regressions, use an aria-live="polite" region and also update aria-roledescription on the list when new items arrive. inline edits need aria-labels and role="status" feedback after save.

Sam (Evals): for thresholds: inline edit is nice but we need to attach metadata (who changed, timestamp, prompt-set version). show a tiny history chevron in the scorecard cell that expands to a changelog. also please add an undo toast after save.

Ava (Design): Agree inline > modal for speed. But UX detail: when someone edits a threshold inline, show a subtle confirmation step — 'preview affected tests (x)' before final commit. otherwise accidental mass changes are scary. Copy nudge: use 'Mark as reviewed' instead of 'Approve' in bulk flows.

Lukas (Frontend): quick keyboard mapping proposal (we can tweak):
```
j/k  -> move selection down/up
Enter -> expand selected diff
a -> approve selected
s -> skip / mark reviewed
Shift+a -> approve all visible
? -> show shortcuts overlay
```
Need to implement a focused list container with aria-activedescendant so screen readers follow.

Priya (A11y): +1 to aria-activedescendant. Also ensure the shortcuts overlay is reachable via keyboard and has role="dialog" with aria-modal="false" (so VO users know it’s contextual). for the undo toast, make it focusable and provide a clear text link 'Undo last threshold change'.

Maya (Designer): one more visual nit: when density is condensed remove the subtle separators — they make rows feel cramped. also test the hit target sizes in condensed mode (>= 44px recommended).

Sam (Evals): small product constraint: when condensing, we still need to show the regression badge count. maybe collapse the diff preview to a single-line summary but keep the badge.

EvalsBot: new prototype deployed to staging: /app/evals?variant=compact-density-2026 — run through and report any regressions.

Rajat (PM): summary / action items: Maya -> finalize presets + preview states. Priya -> list required ARIA attributes and sample markup. Lukas -> spike virtualization/condensed fixed-height approach and implement keyboard map POC. Sam -> add changelog UI + undo toast spec. Ava -> add 'preview affected tests' microflow and copy tweak suggestion. I'll collect and ship a single backlog ticket by EOD. :thumbsup:
